source: Nexon, 'Maplayer One Challenger World and Burning Events!' (news id 47305, 11 Nov 2026), cross-checked with the v.272 patch notes (id 47132); read 23 Nov 2026. Every end-of-season step and date is from that notice.
name: Challenger World Season 4
unknown: Nexon has not published this season's World Leap rules yet: which worlds you can leap to, what transfers and what is deleted are not stated. Check again once the notice appears (the first leap window opens on 16 Dec 2026).

actions.label: Claim every Challenger tier reward
actions.detail: Bronze to Platinum rewards can only be claimed inside Challenger World; Emerald and above can also be claimed in the main world via the Event List.
actions.quote: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum Tier Rewards: Claimable only in Challenger World.

actions.label: Spend all Challenger Coins and Advanced Challenger Coins
actions.detail: The Challenger World Shop runs only until season end; the notice does not say leftover coins are kept or converted.
actions.quote: Spend Challenger Coins earned from completing missions in the Challenger World Shop

actions.label: Claim all Challenger Pass rewards
actions.detail: Pass rewards can be claimed once, by any Challenger World character, only until the season ends.
actions.quote: Rewards can be claimed until February 9, 2027 at 11:59 PM UTC.

actions.label: Reach target Challenger Points tier before the season ends
actions.detail: Tiers: Bronze 5,000; Silver 10,000; Gold 15,000; Platinum 20,000; Emerald 30,000; Sapphire 40,000; Diamond 50,000; Master 70,000 plus Normal Mayrin solo; Challenger 90,000 plus Hard Mayrin solo.
actions.quote: Earn Challenger Points through missions to increase your Tier, unlock rewards, and strengthen your Challenger Buff skill.

actions.label: Claim Defeat Mayrin Event rewards inside Challenger World
actions.detail: Clear rewards must be claimed from the Event List in the Challenger World where the mission was completed.
actions.quote: Rewards can only be claimed in the Challenger World where the mission was completed.

actions.label: Finish Item Burning Plus stage missions before World Leaping
actions.detail: Stage missions and further Challenger Equipment enhancement stop once the character World Leaps, and the event ends with the season.
actions.quote: Item Burning Plus Missions can no longer be completed after a World Leap.

actions.label: Prepare replacement gear for the Challenger Equipment set
actions.detail: The Item Burning Plus Challenger Equipment set stops being usable at season end.
actions.quote: All Challenger Equipment is untradable and can be used until February 9, 2027 11:59 PM UTC.

actions.label: Claim Beyond Burning level rewards and use them
actions.detail: Beyond Burning rewards are claimable until season end and usable until 2027-02-10 02:00 UTC.
actions.quote: Rewards are untradable and can be used until February 10, 2027 at 2:00 AM UTC.

actions.label: Open Tera Burning Gift boxes and use the title coupon
actions.detail: Tera Burning Gift chests, equipment boxes and the Eternal Flame Title Coupon expire at season end.
actions.quote: Eternal Flame Title Coupon: Untradable, expires February 9, 2027 at 11:59 PM UTC.

actions.label: Use time-limited shop items before they expire
actions.detail: Most shop items (cubes, flames, Sol Erda, Star Force enhancement, potential scrolls) expire shortly after season end; only Sol Erda Fragments are listed as permanent for Heroic.
actions.quote: Karma Solid Cube: Tradable within world, expires February 10, 2027 at 2:00 AM UTC.

actions.label: Use claimed Challenger Pass rewards
actions.detail: Claimed pass rewards expire about two hours after season end, except Sol Erda Fragments which are permanent.
actions.quote: All claimed Challenger Pass rewards are tradable within world and expire February 10, 2027 at 2:00 AM UTC.

actions.label: Use Mayrin reward coupons before they expire
actions.detail: The face/hair voucher, outfit set coupon, label/chat ring coupon, soul box, background coupon and finishing effect coupon all expire shortly after season end.
actions.quote: Guide of Fate Outfit Set Coupon: Tradable within world, expires February 10, 2027 at 2:00 AM UTC.

actions.label: Turn in Fragments of Altered Fate (10 per Eternal armor piece)
actions.detail: Mayrin fragments expire shortly after season end, so leftover fragments below a multiple of 10 are lost.
actions.quote: Collect 10 Fragments to obtain one Eternal Armor piece (Hat, Top, Bottom, or Shoulder).

actions.label: Use Hyper Burning MAX reward boxes and coupons
actions.detail: Hyper Burning MAX reward items (symbol selector coupons, ring coupons, nodestones, flames) expire shortly after season end; unclaimed rewards can still be claimed after a leap.
actions.quote: Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (x400): Untradable, expires February 10, 2027 at 2:00 AM UTC.

actions.label: World Leap the character out of Challenger World
actions.detail: Two leap windows are stated: from 16 Dec 2026 (after maintenance) to Wed 10 Feb 2027, 08:59 KST, then a final window from 10 Feb 2027 (after maintenance) to Wed 24 Feb 2027, 08:59 KST; what happens to characters that never leap is not stated.
actions.quote: Challenger World End of World Leap: February 10, 2027 (after maintenance) - February 23, 2027 11:59 PM UTC

counters.source: Challenger Pass: Nexon's Challenger World notice (news id 47305, 11 Nov 2026). Supply Report and Defense Mission: Nexon v.272 patch notes (news id 47132, 11 Nov 2026), Operation Ultima section. Read 27 Nov 2026. Your counts are typed in from the game.

pass.label: Challenger Pass
pass.scope: Level, points and weekly missions are shared by your characters in Challenger World.
pass.quote: The Challenger Pass can be leveled up to Lv. 30 and for every 100 points obtained your Challenger Pass will increase by one level. A maximum of 500 points can be obtained per week.

supply.label: Supply Report
supply.perDayQuote: Supplies are automatically collected upon daily login. (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news id 47132, Supply Report section; read 27 Nov 2026.)
supply.scope: Shared by every character on the account. One collection a day you log in, up to 5 a week.
supply.resetNote: Nexon does not say which day the Supply Report week starts.
supply.archiveNote: Each week with all 5 collections also unlocks one Ultima Archive record; the last Archive reward needs 12.
supply.quote: Supplies can be collected up to 5 times per week, up to 60 times during the event period.

defense.label: Defense Mission
defense.scope: Shared by every character on the account. One completion per 2,000 kills near your level, up to 5 a week.
defense.quote: The Defense Mission can be completed up to 5 times per week, up to 60 times during the event period.

counters.buyBackNote: Nexon sells missed Supply and Defense weeks for Maple Points. Everything they give expires on 10 Feb 2027, so the tracker never counts on that.

expiring.label: HEXA Matrix and Erda Link Reset Scrolls
expiring.detail: Free from Maple Administrator, once per character, after the 6th job. Only worth claiming if you want to move your nodes.
expiring.quote: HEXA Matrix Reset Scroll: Untradable, expires December 16, 2026 2:00 AM UTC.

expiring.label: Specter Blast reward coupons (Gaon's Spear, Keiraroid, the Turtle medal)
expiring.detail: Use the coupons to turn them into the permanent items before they expire.
expiring.quote: Gaon's Spear Coupon: Tradable within world, expires December 16, 2026 at 2:00 AM UTC.

expiring.label: Etherion: spend it on your cores
expiring.detail: Etherion cannot be obtained or used after this.
expiring.quote: cannot be obtained or used after February 9, 2027 at 11:59 PM UTC.

expiring.label: Supply Report and Ultima Archive rewards
expiring.detail: Claim them by Tue 9 Feb 23:59 UTC (Wed 10 Feb 08:59 KST) and use them before this. That includes the Growth Potion (200 - 279), the cube and flame stacks and the selector coupons. Coupons that give a permanent item (mount, chair set, medal) must be used to keep the item.
expiring.quote: Claimed rewards can be used until February 10, 2027 at 2:00 AM UTC.

expiring.label: Etherion Overload Medal Coupon
expiring.detail: Given at a combined core level of 30. The medal itself is permanent once the coupon is used.
expiring.quote: Etherion Overload Medal Coupon: Tradable within world, expires February 10, 2027 at 2:00 AM UTC.

expiringNote: From the coin shops (Nexon's patch notes, read by the 6-hourly job) and a short list typed in from news ids 47132 and 47305. Sol Erda Fragments and items marked permanent do not expire.

notes.label: Open 7-day Mayrin boxes within 7 days of obtaining them
notes.detail: Eternal armor boxes, Sol Erda Fragment boxes and the Pitched accessory box from Mayrin are 7-day items.
notes.quote: Fated Eternal Armor Box Untradable, 7-day duration

notes.label: Do not rely on season-only power after leaving
notes.detail: The Challenger buff skill, supported Sol Janus level and Arcane Core stats do not carry over after a World Leap.
notes.quote: stats obtained from equipping an Arcane Core will not apply if you World Leap from Challenger World to another world

notes.label: Use Straight to Lv. 200 / Lv. 250 Potions outside Challenger World
notes.detail: Emerald and Master tier level potions cannot be used in Challenger World, so plan to use them in the main world; no expiry date is given in the notice.
notes.quote: Cannot be used in Challenger World.
